scope: Read-only visual inspection of all actual HTTP front/reduced screenshot pairs, independent of Blender model evidence and functional tests.

observations.description: Some selection captions expose COM IDs and Blender production method labels; root is cleaning runtime display names for v006 without changing canonical model names.

separate_functional_status.reason: Root/direct protocol agent reported v005 900x600 Tab coordinate issue and transition-duration issue; v006 is a new build and must have new evidence.

limits: Only actual screenshot states at 1440x900 and900x600; arbitrary rotations, closeups, texture filtering/mips, mobile/GPU performance are not fully covered.
No assertion that screenshot review independently proves every small component or interaction; use805-placement/native/runtime evidence separately.
v006 will be reviewed from its own actual screenshots; this verdict is not copied.
